{{Quote|Like riding on a cloud made of spun Dramassian silk!|Luminara Unduli|<ref name="TAS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>}}
'''Dramassian shimmersilk''', also known as '''Dramassian silk''', was a soft, smooth, and sheer [[Shimmersilk/Legends|shimmersilk]] that was produced on the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dramassia]] from at least [[3643 BBY]] onwards. The [[Silk/Legends|silk]] was used in the production of [[curtain]]s as well as in various types of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]].

==Description==
Dramassian shimmersilk<ref name="Rebel Force" /> was an exceptionally<ref name="TEA" /> soft, smooth,<ref name="TAS" /> and luxuriously sheer<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Shimmersilk/Legends|shimmersilk]]<ref name="Rebel Force" /> originating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dramassia]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]'s [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was used to create [[curtain]]s<ref name="Rebel Force" /> and various types of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]], such as [[shirt]]s,<ref name="DoE" /> [[Robe/Legends|robes]],<ref name="Lockdown">''[[Maul: Lockdown]]''</ref> [[Boot/Legends|boots]],<ref name="Dramassian Silk Boots">{{TORcite|type=other|Sacred Dramassian Silk Boots}}</ref> [[Hat/Legends|headgear]],<ref name="Dramassian Silk Headgear">{{TORcite|type=other|Sacred Dramassian Silk Headgear}}</ref> [[Glove/Legends|gloves]],<ref name="Dramassian Silk Gloves">{{TORcite|type=other|Traditional Dramassian Silk Gloves}}</ref> and [[Sash/Legends|sashes]].<ref name="Dramassian Silk Sash">{{TORcite|type=other|Traditional Dramassian Silk Sash}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Suubatars.jpg|250px|left|thumb|Several Jedi riding suubatars on Ansion, which Luminara Unduli (not pictured) compared to the feeling of Dramassian silk.]]
Dramassian shimmersilk was produced throughout the era of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="CSWE" /> beginning in at least [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="TOR date" /> By that date, the silk was found throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="Dramassian Silk">{{TORcite|type=other|Dramassian Silk}}</ref> and was being used in the creation of clothing.<ref name="Dramassian Silk Boots" /> After the [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region by the [[Elder Houses]] around [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], Dramassian silk became a major export of Dramassia alongside [[Mining/Legends|mining]] equipment, causing the planet to become a regional economic powerhouse. Despite this, the planet's controllers, [[House Halliikeenovich]], were looked down upon by some [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], who believed the planet's economic power was vaguely unseemly.<ref name="TEA" /> In [[980 BBY]],<ref name="DoE date">The events of ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'' take place twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]], which [[The New Essential Chronology]] dates to [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], twenty years before [[980 BBY]].</ref> the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Set Harth]] wore a [[Color/Legends|turquoise-blue]] Dramassian silk shirt in his [[Set Harth's mansion|mansion]]<ref name="DoE" /> on the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] when he was [[Duel in Set Harth's mansion|confronted]] by the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]].<ref name="DoE" />

Several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] later in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="Lockdown date">{{InsiderCite|146|Blaster}} dates the events of ''[[Maul: Lockdown]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].</ref> another [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] apprentice, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], wore a Dramassian silk bathrobe.<ref name="Lockdown" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TAS date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]</ref> just prior to the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] compared riding her [[suubatar]] mount animal<ref name="TAS" /> on the [[Grass/Legends|grassland]] planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] to riding a [[Cloud/Legends|cloud]] made of spun Dramassian silk, owing to the extraordinary smoothness of the creature's gait.<ref name="TAS" /> The [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> planet [[Nyemari]]'s [[Nyemari Royal Palace|Royal Palace]] possessed thin Dramassian shimmersilk curtains within a shoe closet that was used as a hiding place by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]<ref name="Rebel Force" /> three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Rebel Force date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]'' to three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Scourge date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']] to [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].</ref> the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Reen Irana]] wore a silver-gray shirt of Dramassian shimmersilk which she believed blended well with her azure skin.<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dramassian shimmersilk was first mentioned, as Dramassian silk, in the [[2002]] novel ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'' written by [[Alan Dean Foster]].<ref name="TAS" /> It later first appeared in [[2009]], in clothing form, in the third book of the [[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy|''Darth Bane Trilogy'']], ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'' by [[Drew Karpyshyn]].<ref name="DoE" /> The silk was further identified as a type of shimmersilk by the [[2010]] young-reader novel ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]'', the sixth and final installment of the ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'' series written by [[Alex Wheeler]].<ref name="Rebel Force" /> The [[2014]] novel ''[[Maul: Lockdown]]'' by [[Joe Schreiber]] misspells "Dramassian" as "Dramasian" in its sole mention.<ref name="Lockdown" />

In the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', Dramassian silk exists as a Grade 3 Luxury Fabric crafting item,<ref name="Dramassian Silk" /> and four armor sets are prefixed with Dramassian silk: Sacred,<ref name="Sacred Dramassian Silk">{{TORcite|type=other|Sacred Dramassian Silk armor}}</ref> Traditional,<ref name="Traditional Dramassian Silk">{{TORcite|type=other|Traditional Dramassian Silk armor}}</ref> Anointed,<ref name="Anointed Dramassian Silk">{{TORcite|type=other|Anointed Dramassian Silk armor}}</ref> and Veiled.<ref name="Veiled Dramassian Silk">{{TORcite|type=other|Veiled Dramassian Silk armor}}</ref>
